children: Indian Hotels Company (IHCL) has opened Taj Pushkar Resort & Spa in Pushkar, Rajasthan, adding a 111-key property to its state portfolio.

Commenting on the opening, Gaurav Pokhariyal, Chief Operating Officer – Full Service Business, IHCL, said, “With the opening of Taj Pushkar Resort & Spa, we are extending the travel circuit in one of country’s most visited state. Combining the warmth of Taj hospitality with the region’s rich traditions, the resort offers an immersive gateway to Pushkar. Nestled on the edge of the Thar Desert, it is among Rajasthan's most iconic destinations, celebrated for its spiritual significance and vibrant culture.”

Spread across landscaped grounds overlooking the surrounding desert terrain, the resort features garden-facing rooms inspired by the region's architectural heritage. Its dining options include Shamiana, an all-day dining restaurant serving global cuisine, and Nonya, which offers Pan-Asian food. The hotel's bar, House of Nomad, serves signature cocktails, while Tropics offers a poolside setting.
The property also houses the J Wellness Circle Spa, offering therapies and wellness rituals rooted in India's traditional approaches to holistic healing.

Vikas Nagar, General Manager, Taj Pushkar Resort & Spa, Rajasthan, said, “Taj Pushkar Resort & Spa has been designed to reflect the spirit of its destination. We look forward to welcoming guests to experience Pushkar through a blend of authentic local experiences and heartfelt service.”
Pushkar's cultural heritage and spiritual significance make it a destination for experiential travel in Rajasthan.
